purpose: Auditor-required receipt: four workspace gates on ONE coherent assembly, for the report-truth repair (dirty/ahead/pending rows can no longer be counted clean).

repair.defect: `ok` in `dracon-sync repos` was a RESIDUAL bucket (rows - (concern+active+warn)), so DIRTY / AHEAD / PENDING rows were counted as "clean". The earlier fleet-acceptance evidence was accepted on that total (ok=36) while 14 of 36 rows carried outstanding work.
repair.fix: `row_is_converged()` is now the definition of clean, and the buckets are DERIVED from it; a new `pending` bucket makes the outstanding class explicit instead of rounding it into either `ok` or a failure. Bucket sum is asserted to equal the row count.
